acceptance_criteria: Each listed bead split or its working rule recorded
description:
CLAUDE.md says never start a bead labelled 'human'. But several human-labelled beads describe agent work: p4-real-content ('The agent may convert supplied drafts to the content format and run lint'), p10-secrets ('Generate production secrets on the server' before the HUMAN storage part), p10-codes (run the generator against production), p10-accounts (create accounts and the pilot class), p10-go-live (launch). As written, an agent can never do its part.

Options: split each into an agent bead and a human bead with an edge between them, or have a human claim the bead and explicitly hand the agent its part in-session.

Filed during beads setup (prompt 01, step 8).
title: DECISION: beads labelled human that also contain agent work
